title: Senior Engineer - Plant Maintenance
jobDescription:
Senior Engineer Maintenance Weir Minerals Bangalore, India Onsite The Senior Engineer is accountable for optimizing machinery and equipment uptime to ensure the achievement of operational plans. This role involves transforming the maintenance culture from a reactive “breakdown and repair” approach to a systems-based, structured problem-solving methodology. Why choose Weir: Be part of a global organization dedicated to building a better future: At Weir, the growing world depends on us. Apply strong technical knowledge of PLC and CNC machine controls, including the monitoring and maintenance of electrical equipment. Promote a proactive mindset by fostering a culture that views equipment failures as preventable through systematic problem solving. Drive improvements in equipment and machinery reliability, using machine uptime as a key performance indicator. Strengthen organisational capability by implementing lean tools such as 6S, Process Management, TPM, standardised work, and rapid cycle improvements. Maximise plant uptime and process efficiency through predictive and preventative maintenance strategies, leveraging the SAP system for planning and execution. title: Senior Engineer - SCM
jobDescription:
Sr. Engineer
- SCM Location
- Bangalore Work Arrangement
- Onsite What we do at Weir We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining. Make your impact You’ll play a key role in solving real-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future. What you’ll do Export & Import Documentation Management: Track and maintain export control sheets and documents including invoices, shipping bills, BL, EBRC, RODTEP scrip, and IGST refund on export. Monitor and track import shipments and maintain import control sheets (DSR). Audit & Compliance Coordination: Handle customs and audit queries including SVB audits. Coordinate with finance teams for EDPMS and IDPMS closures related to e-BRCs. Manage post-export processes such as stuffing, local EGM, and gateway EGM, ensuring error rectification. Freight & Vendor Negotiation: Negotiate freight costs, finalize shipments, freight rate contracts with freight forwarders, and select customs handling agents. Verify shipping bills, bills of entry checklists, and vendor bills against contractual rates and RFQs. Regulatory & Policy Expertise: Finalize HSN codes for products and spares. Arrange various export and import documents such as ARE, DBK, SDF, EVD, SLI, KYC, GR waiver, FEMA, and certificates like SIMS & CIMS. Manage preferential and non-preferential COOs via DGFT. Export Incentives & Refunds: Claim duty drawback, MEIS scrip, Ro DTEP, and GST refunds on exports. Play a key role in enrolling WMI to AEO Tier-1 and Status Holder
3. Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Interco Sales and Store teams to ensure smooth export sales and timely receipt of import materials for factory GRN. Reporting & Support: Prepare monthly, half-yearly, and yearly EXIM, GST refund, DBK, GIT, and MEIS & Ro DTEP utilization reports. Support all activities related to the Impex and Finance/accounts departments. Travel Requirements: Minimal travel may be required to coordinate with freight forwarders, customs agents, or attend audits. Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture. What you’ll bring Must-haves: Strong knowledge of export and import documentation, freight, and customs handling agent negotiation skills. Expertise in DGFT, ICEGATE, Customs, CBIC, FIEO, Indian Trade Portal, and AEO processes. In-depth understanding of Foreign Trade Policies (2015 & 2023), INCO-TERMS, High Sea Sale, and HSN codes. Proven experience handling post-customs audits and export incentives including GST refund, duty drawback, MEIS, and Ro DTEP. Nice-to-haves: Experience with second-hand capital goods and break bulk shipments. Familiarity with export control systems and software tools for documentation and reporting. Prior involvement in enrollment and compliance for AEO Tier-1 and Status Holder 3 certifications. Strong analytical skills with attention to detail in reviewing and correcting documentation errors. Why join Weir? We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes. We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies. We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives. Benefits Competitive pay Career development and learning support Access to global inclusion networks Regional and team-specific benefits Sharebuilder scheme Wellness support for you and your family Collaboration with global teams Study support We are Weir. And the growing world depends on us. It depends on us constantly reinventing. Quickly adapting. Continually finding better, faster, more sustainable ways to access the resources it needs to thrive. And it depends on each and every one of us doing the best work of our lives. It’s a big challenge – but it’s exciting. And it’s one we can’t wait to be part of. Thank you for your interest in joining us.

Knowledge of system engineering and integration of mechanical equipment like pumps and valves. title: AI Tooling Administrator
jobDescription: AI Tooling Administrator Location: Bangalore Work Arrangement: Hybrid What we do at Weir We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet's future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining. Make your impact As an AI Tooling Administrator, you will play a critical role in enabling and scaling Weir's enterprise AI capabilities. You will be responsible for the administration, governance, security, adoption, and optimisation of AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Git Hub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, and future enterprise AI services. Working at the intersection of AI Governance, Cyber Security, Fin Ops, Enterprise Architecture, and Business teams, you will help ensure that AI delivers measurable business value while remaining secure, compliant, and cost-effective. This role is central to Weir's transition from isolated AI experimentation to a governed enterprise AI operating model. What You'll Do Tenant & Platform Administration: Configure and administer enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Git Hub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, and future enterprise AI solutions at the tenant and organizational level. Define baseline configurations, establish separation between pilot, testing, and production environments, and maintain platform settings aligned with enterprise standards and architecture. Identity, Access & User Lifecycle Management: Integrate AI platforms with enterprise identity providers such as Entra ID, support machine identity implementation, manage role-based access controls (RBAC), and govern joiners, movers, leavers, and periodic access reviews. Enforce segregation of duties and alignment with enterprise security policies. Licensing, Token Governance & Cost Optimization: Manage AI platform licensing, entitlements, token consumption, and budget controls across the organization. Optimize license allocation, monitor utilization, reduce waste, prevent duplicate tooling investments, and minimize unmanaged or shadow AI adoption. Partner with Fin Ops teams to provide transparency of AI spend and maximize value from investment. Security & Data Protection: Partner with Sec Ops and Cyber Security teams to establish and enforce controls for handling personal data, commercially sensitive information, intellectual property, customer information, supplier information, and source code. Configure retention policies, workspace permissions, integration restrictions, and security controls to mitigate risks such as prompt injection and data leakage. Compliance, Audit & Responsible AI: Enable audit logging, monitoring, and traceability across enterprise AI platforms. Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, security, privacy, and internal governance requirements. Support AI Governance teams in establishing and maintaining responsible AI standards, policies, and operating procedures. Integration Governance & Agentic AI Enablement: Govern integrations, plugins, connectors, and enterprise AI extensions across platforms including SAP, Service Now, Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and other enterprise systems. Promote API-led integration patterns and support Agentic AI programmes and cross-system AI initiatives. Maintain an approved catalogue of integrations and usage patterns. Adoption, Enablement & Value Realization: Drive AI onboarding, training, education, and adoption across business functions. Develop guidance, playbooks, best practices, and reusable use-case patterns. Monitor adoption, business value, platform performance, and user satisfaction. Identify optimization opportunities and support AI service intake, approval processes, and enterprise AI operating models. Stakeholder, Governance & Vendor Collaboration: Work closely with AI Governance, Cyber Security (Sec Ops), Fin Ops, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Procurement, and IT teams to ensure AI platforms are operated in accordance with enterprise policies and standards. Manage stakeholder expectations, balance business demand with risk, governance, security, and budget considerations, and facilitate decision-making across multiple stakeholder groups. Partner with vendors including Microsoft, Anthropic, Git Hub, Google, and other AI providers regarding product roadmaps, licensing, platform capabilities, and support models. Support alignment with Weir's enterprise AI strategy and operating model. Strategic AI Governance: Support Group, Enterprise, Architecture, Governance, and Tooling teams in shaping and executing Weir's multi-year AI adoption strategy. Contribute to enterprise AI operating models, governance frameworks, tooling roadmaps, and strategic investment decisions while considering ongoing business transformation programmes and future technology direction. Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero-harm behaviours in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture. What You'll Bring Must-Haves Hands-on experience administering enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Git Hub Copilot, Anthropic Claude Enterprise/Claude Code, Google Gemini, Azure AI Foundry, or similar enterprise AI solutions. Strong understanding of AI/LLM technologies, enterprise AI use cases, AI governance, and responsible AI principles. Experience managing AI platform licensing, entitlements, token consumption, and cost optimization initiatives. Strong knowledge of identity and access management, tenant administration, machine identities, RBAC, and user lifecycle governance.
